premises: Sins such as the killing of a brahman are mentioned.
Meritorious fruits such as the horse sacrifice are mentioned.
Both categories are presented together as comparable cases.
inference: Both grave sins like brahman-killing and great merits like the horse sacrifice are brought into the same frame.
